g.text: DEMO: memory only / no models | Stage: Explore
Repeated computation, I/O or locks: where is time actually spent?
Separate the reported observation from possible explanations.
A cache is premature until the cause of the slowdown is better
The cause is not established. Magnitude and novelty remain
Explore > Critique > Brief final > Build > Accept > Done
You are in Explore. A scoped review does not advance the stage.
